subject: gk
question:
The question consists of two statements, namely, Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Use them to choose the correct alternative.

**Assertion (A):** Pocket money given by parents is included while estimating national income

**Reason (R): **It represents a transfer of payment from parents to children

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true and R is false
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false but R is true

solution:
The correct answer is __**A is false but R is true**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Measures of National Income:**

 
 
• **GDP** (Gross Domestic Product)
 
• **NDP** (Net Domestic Product)
 
• **GNP** (Gross National Product)
 
• **NNP** (Net National Product)
 
 
 
• So **the Assertion (A) is false**.
 
• **Pocket Money:**
 
 
• A **small amount of money** is given to a **child** by their **parents**, typically on a regular basis.
 
• So it represents a transfer of payment from parents to children.
 
 
 
• So **the reason (R) is true**.
